skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the role of financial systems
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the role of financial systems and financial analysts in businesses.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing financial situations based on reports
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students apply and analyze financial situations based on business financial reports.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Calculating interest rates and cash flows
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students calculate various types of interest rates and cash flows, analyzing household and business financial decisions.
Students analyze and evaluate investment projects, understanding market value estimation and asset valuation principles.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying theories to financial analysis scenarios
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students apply theories to financial analysis scenarios and use analytical tools proficiently to make financial decisions.
Students work independently and in teams, organizing discussions to solve class scenario problems.
Students have self-study and research abilities, organizing group work situations to achieve learning objectives.
Students have discipline and cooperation awareness, showing responsibility in group activities.
